descriptor: Freight and delivery planning for fleets

voice.summary: targo talks like a dispatcher on a deadline: short, bold and sure of the route. It states routes, windows and promises in plain words and keeps the replies fast.
dos: Mention routes, windows and fleets by name
Promise a reply time and keep it
donts: Use vague promises like 'best in class'

taglines: Talk to someone who moves freight
boilerplate: targo is a logistics company that plans routes, fleets and delivery windows for businesses, with a specialist who replies to every enquiry within one business day.

microcopy.success: Request sent. We reply within one business day.

microcopy.empty: No shipments yet. Book your first.
